title: ArrowYesNo
description: Per-call schema for the decomposed arrow yes/no calls. Asks whether a candidate (from_id, to_id) pair represents a real cause-and-effect arrow in the strategy map. Many of these fire in parallel (one per candidate pair); the assembly layer filters to enables=true and constructs Arrow records. When enables is true, hypothesis MUST be a non-null string of 20-500 characters (matches the Arrow Pydantic model's non-nullable string constraint). When enables is false, hypothesis must be null.
